candidate_evidence.quote: Patients receive a gadolinium-based contrast agent and undergo DSC-MRI scans at 4 and 8 weeks after completion of standard of care (SOC) radiation therapy.

source_quote.quote: Patient must have newly diagnosed GBM (must be IDH wild type), with pathologic proof, based on World Health Organization (WHO) 2021 criteria.
Patient must have O6-Methylguanine-DNA Methyltransferase (MGMT) methylation status ordered at time of registration.

coder_notes: Imaging-biomarker diagnostic study; only diagnostic agents (gadolinium contrast, 18F-fluciclovine), no pharmacological antitumour candidate. MGMT: the entry criterion is that MGMT status be ordered at registration, not a required value; coded as eligibility literally but it is not a selection on MGMT result. Marker positive/negative in the outcomes refers to imaging markers, not molecular biomarkers.
